note: Track tunes, step 1: three Easy Do Re Mi tunes at 40 bpm, sung along, sung on "la", then sung from memory in the named stages (Tune muted over the chords, then Chords muted for a cappella) in place of the old Stop. Key and tempo are moves in place of the old Key selector.

exercise.title: Short tunes on Do, Re and Mi
exercise.why: A tune you can sing after it stops is one your ear has kept, so each tune here is heard, sung along with, then sung alone.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. The tune steps up from Do to Mi and back. Sing along on the note names.
Once you can sing it without the tune leading you, press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords alone.
{{?key}}In another key the notes are new, and the tune keeps its shape.

Press Play below to hear the tune: the mic starts with it. This tune is four bars long, and its second half answers the first. Sing along on the note names.
Once the names come without thinking, sing it again on "la".

Press Play below to hear the tune, and only listen the first time. Then press Play again and sing along. Sing it on "la".
Press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords from memory. Then press Chords to mute the chords too, and sing it a cappella.
If the middle is gone, press Tune to bring the tune back and hum along quietly once.
